coordinate_identity: SHA256 of schema stage4-cell-coordinate-v1 and four coordinates, first24hex; independent of weights, ceilings and paths
execution_identity: v5.2 planned definition binds historical template and dataset layout; final code/recipe/population/cost receipt still required

multiplicity.coverage: nominal approximate bootstrap; three clusters do not establish exact familywise coverage

name: run_matrix_v5_2_option_D

queue.attempts: new attempt-0000, attempt-0001, ...; never overwrite a completed or failed attempt
queue.ceiling_definition: wall_seconds is admitted solo ceiling = 1.5 * measured full solo process cost
queue.charged_budget: sum of process envelopes, including overlap and failures; separate from elapsed queue wall time
queue.completed_cell: skip only when a terminal receipt chain and matching completion result verify against the bound matrix
queue.freeze: final driver/analysis/code/environment identities must be rebound after approved scoring/driver edits
queue.host_failure: stop new dispatch on memory/lease/host failure; charge running workers; torn state or unknown cost needs owner reconciliation
queue.identity_mismatch: abort without issuing checkpoint receipt; stop queue for owner reconciliation, never silently rebind or skip
queue.incremental_resume: verify every prior journal including failed/unreceipted work; torn/open intent or unknown spend refuses automatic resume

optional_between_B3_B4.run_if: lead decision on Q4/Q5 and separate bound budget

queue.resume: verify unique contiguous checkpoint prefix, receipt chain, recipe, code, payload, base/config/reader and snapshot/state hashes; restore last durable checkpoint
queue.retry: R1-77f: one automatic retry from certified state; second failure incomplete, continue next cell without draining other worker; preserve same queue receipt root
queue.shutdown: stop at experiment deadline 2026-10-09; report complete blocks plus exact incomplete cell/checkpoint IDs under DEC-052
